dialogs.text: #What is it, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Is there anything else you want to ask?
About that crab...
*sigh* It looks scary, but it's always been gentle. It'll probably return to normal now that the stone's gone.
But for now, let's leave it to hide away and reflect on its actions. Manipulated or not, what's done is done, and it still hurt all those little crabs.
Just like that bad governor who went up against Reed Miller while under the mirror's spell — excuses don't change the fact that you have to right wrongs with action.
Tell me about that strange stone...
Hehe, that's the st{RUBY#[D]Twardowska's Stone}one of desire, an item that can manipulate human hearts... Hmm, at least I think that's the name Big Sis Hidimbi mentioned?
*ahem* A—Anyway, it's something that fell out of the skies, like that giant rock over where the Frostmoon Scions live. Since it flew away, we should be safe now.
Tell me about the Conch Gang...
#Hmm? You wanna learn about us, {M#brother}{F#sister}? Sure. You're already a friend of ours, anyway.
We're like a... Hmm, a mutual aid and coordination organization for like-minded people of similar age. It's a shame that you're too old to join us, but...
If you should ever need help with anything in Nasha Town while I'm around and able, just call on me!
About that odd person from before...
Oh, you mean that purple-haired priestess. She hasn't made a move against us yet, so at least she's not our enemy — for now. We should try to stay out of her business as much as possible, though.

Curiosity can prove deadly. Big Sis Katya also warned against making contact with those Frostmoon weirdos, and for good reason — even a master thief like myself was almost caught and sacrificed to their Moon Goddess once.
Sacrificed!?
Yeah, those folks are really creepy. I've heard that they take blood from different people and... Ugh, just thinking about it gives me the chills. Let's leave it at that.
Fortunately, the one who caught me was just a naive little girl. She agreed to let me go after I told her a few stories. Otherwise...
I—I wasn't scared, really. A master thief never gets scared! Just a word of advice for you, though — stay away from them.
Ah, right, I almost forgot about the informant I promised you details about earlier. All that I learned about the Frostmoon Scions, I got from Big Sis Hidimbi.
If you wanna find her... Well, I think she's still around Nasha Town. Ask around and you should find out.
She'll be taking a long break, I think...
Hmm? So you've met her already? I never heard her mention taking time off... Ah well, that can wait.
Doesn't sound all that reliable...
Oh, don't worry. She's super reliable. Trust in Maite, and set your worries aside!
See you.
Alright. Safe travels, buddy.
Whoa! Did this guy get even bigger than before?
Hehe, of course. After eating all those Lakkaberries that I worked hard to find, His Majesty the Tsar is now even plumper and chubbier than you are, Paimon.
Hey! Cut it out with the weird comparisons!
#Whoa! It seems to have gotten energized all of a sudden... Or should I say, excited, when it saw you, {NICKNAME}.
Looks like it wants to challenge you... Hah, is it feeling sore that you beat it black and blue the last time?
Bring it on!
Be careful. It's much stronger than it was last time.
Huh? Right now?
There's no need to indulge its whims, really. You can accept its challenge whenever you feel like it.
It's under my protection now, so it will listen to what I say.
Hey now, be good. Sit.
You say this like it's your pet dog or something... Wait, aren't crabs sitting down all the time to begin with?
